cases.subject: Claim Decision Regarding CCS-2026-000908
cases.body:
Dear Jordan Patel,

We have completed our review of your collision claim. At this time, your claim is denied.

This decision was reached because the vehicle was being used for paid deliveries while logged into a delivery app at the time of the loss. Your policy includes the following provision: "[EXC-2] We will not pay for loss to your covered auto while it is being used to carry persons or property for a fee, including while the driver is logged in to a transportation network or delivery platform."

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any questions regarding this letter.

ClaimPilot Claims Team

cases.subject: Claim Decision Regarding CCS-2026-000909
cases.body:
Dear Jordan Patel,

We have completed our review of your claim regarding the incident on 2026-04-12. At this time, your claim is denied.

Our records indicate that the damage is limited to a mechanical breakdown of the engine, with no collision or other covered event. Your policy includes the following exclusion: "[EXC-1] We will not pay for loss due to and confined to wear and tear, freezing, mechanical or electrical breakdown or failure, or road damage to tires, unless the damage results from the total theft of your covered auto." Because the damage falls under this exclusion, it is not covered by your policy.

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any questions regarding this decision.

ClaimPilot Claims Team

cases.subject: Claim Decision Regarding CCS-2026-000910

According to your policy, "[GEN-1] This policy applies only to accidents and losses that occur during the policy period shown in the Declarations and within the United States, its territories or possessions, or Canada."

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any questions regarding this letter.

ClaimPilot Claims Team

cases.body:
Claim number: CCS-2026-000911

Dear Jordan Patel,

We have completed our review of your claim regarding the theft of your vehicle. At this time, your claim is denied.

This decision was reached because your policy provides liability coverage only and does not cover damage to or theft of your own vehicle. Specifically, policy clause [LIAB-2] states: "This policy provides liability coverage only."

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

If you have any questions, please contact us.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
